text: A boiled-milk, back-slopped ferment, so its microbes come from the gourd and the previous batch, not from the raw milk.

adds.vessel: gourd from Lagenaria fruit (preferred) or plastic

processing.text: Cow milk boiled 10 min and cooled first, so the microbes come from the gourd and the previous batch. The pH of 4.54 is after 96 h in a gourd.
